reasons: Deviation is correctly identified: Section 7.3 gives only a 60-day conformance warranty measured from the Effective Date with a December 31, 1999 outside date, below both the 12-month preferred and 90-day fallback positions, and it could lapse at or before completion of Acceptance Testing.

The p0078 edit is targeted and directionally correct — it replaces only the period language with 'twelve (12) months following Corio's acceptance of the Software pursuant to Section 3.1', preserving the conformance, media and no-malicious-code warranties; the failed minimal-edit heuristic (0.837 ratio) is not borne out by the rendered text, which is otherwise identical to the original.

The inserted Section 7.5 supplies the missing professional-and-workmanlike services warranty with re-performance/refund remedy, tracking the playbook model language; the existing 7.3/7.4 correction, replacement and refund remedies are correctly left intact.
Comment is accurate, in the required voice and prefix, explains the acceptance-testing timing problem, and offers the 90-day/30-day fallback.

Minor, non-blocking: the redline does not add a compliance-with-laws warranty referenced in the preferred position, and the new section number (7.5) should be checked against existing Article 7 numbering before sending.
